description: The Contractor shall furnish all key personnel to provide services necessary to perform onsite Radiology Physician Services to eligible beneficiaries of the Department of Veterans Affairs, Oklahoma City VA Health Care System. The VA Radiology Services follow the standards of Abdominal/GU, Breast Imaging, Cardiovascular, General, Interventional, Musculoskeletal, Neuroradiology & guidelines set forth by American College of Radiology (ACR). A contractor providing onsite interventional radiologist services shall provide services that meet or exceed the American College of Radiology Guidelines https://www.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Practice-Parameters/IRClin-Prac-Mgmt.pdf.pdf
